Metadata Store

Compact JSON metadata persistence for chunks.

Read/write token_metadata.json files.

gigacode.metadata_store.save_metadata(path: str | Path, metadata_list: list[dict[str, Any]], *, compact: bool = True) → None[source]

Persist a list of per-line metadata records to JSON.

Retries up to 3 times on transient I/O errors (OSError, IOError, TimeoutError).

Parameters:

  • path – Destination file path.

  • metadata_list – List of metadata dicts (typically from flatten_embeddings()).

  • compact – If True (default) write minified JSON for speed and smaller files. Set to False for human-readable output.

gigacode.metadata_store.load_metadata(path: str | Path) → list[dict[str, Any]][source]

Load per-line metadata records from JSON.

Retries up to 3 times on transient I/O errors.

Parameters:

path – Source file path.

Returns:

The list of line metadata dicts.

Raises:

  • FileNotFoundError – If path does not exist.

  • ValueError – If the JSON schema is unrecognised.
